t: MDB hosts Shadow Minister for Finance Graham Bencini
html:
Malta Development Bank Chairman Leo Brincat and CEO Paul V. Azzopardi hosted a courtesy meeting with Hon. Graham Bencini, the Shadow Minister for Finance at the Bank’s offices in Floriana.

During this meeting, Mr Brincat and Mr Azzopardi shared a preview of the soon-to- be-launched Bank’s Business Strategy for the years ahead and provided a general overview of the key operations and initiatives of the MDB.

This included a run-through of the different financing opportunities which are available for projects undertaken by SMEs and larger firms, social and infrastructural projects and opportunities for students wishing to pursue their studies, among others.
